title: Working at the frontier: How Hebbia builds AI for financial diligence that can't miss a detail
translatedTitle: 在前沿工作：Hebbia 如何打造不容错过任何细节的金融尽调 AI
subtitle: Hebbia builds research and diligence software for financial professionals, and tests every new model against finance evals tied to expert outcomes. In testing, Claude Fable 5 posted the biggest accuracy gain its research team has recorded, and tracked complex queries that prior models kept dropping.
